wttl.title: Who Ticks Too Long
wttl.status.server.value: %s ms/tick averaged over the last 100 ticks
wttl.status.heat.idle: nothing is instrumented and no memory is held
wttl.status.sampler.unavailable: CPU time unavailable on this JVM
wttl.status.auto.on: on · above %s ms/tick with a chunk over %s · %s captured
wttl.heat.enabled: Chunk heat monitoring on. Ranking becomes meaningful after a few seconds of samples.
wttl.heat.disabled: Chunk heat monitoring off. Sample buffer released.
wttl.heat.summary: %s samples · %s of wall time ticking chunks
wttl.heat.off: Chunk heat monitoring is off. Switch it on with /wttl chunk enable.
wttl.heat.no_samples: No samples in the last %s yet.
wttl.heat.all_idle: No chunk work in the last %s. All %s samples caught the server thread idle.
wttl.heat.page_past_end: Page %s is past the end. Only %s chunks were sampled.
wttl.object.started.hint_methods: read it with /wttl object report and /wttl object methods
wttl.object.nothing_yet: Nothing to report. Start one with /wttl object enable <chunkX> <chunkZ>.
wttl.object.no_ticks: No object ticks recorded in chunk [%s, %s] at blocks %s,%s yet. Nothing there is ticking.
wttl.object.instance_cap: too many distinct objects to track them all; type totals are complete
wttl.object.nothing_saved: Nothing to save; no inspection has run.
wttl.method.biased: safepoint biased, treat hot spots as indicative
wttl.method.buffer_full: sample buffers filled, covers only the earlier part
wttl.method.not_sampled: No method samples. Method sampling needs the object tick windows, so start it with /wttl object enable <x> <z> <seconds> methods.
wttl.method.none_inside: No stack samples landed inside the chunk. %s were taken on the server thread. Either the chunk is a very small slice of the tick, or sampling produced nothing.
wttl.auto.enabled: Automatic capture on. It fires when the server averages over %s ms/tick and one chunk holds over %s of chunk tick time.
wttl.auto.needs_heat: It has nothing to watch until chunk heat monitoring is on: /wttl chunk enable
wttl.auto.triggered: Server behind at %s ms/tick. Chunk [%s, %s] at blocks %s,%s in %s holds %s of chunk tick time. Capturing for %ss.
wttl.auto.captured: Capture finished. Chunk [%s, %s] at blocks %s,%s cost %s ms per tick, mostly %s. Read it with /wttl auto show 1
wttl.auto.empty: Nothing captured yet. Reports also land in %s/.
wttl.auto.out_of_range: There are only %s captures. List them with /wttl auto list.
wttl.auto.show_header: Captured automatically at %s · server averaging %s ms/tick
wttl.auto.offline: Inspection finished but whoever started it has left; it is still readable with /wttl object report.
wttl.window.bad_syntax: '%s' is not a duration. Write a number and a unit, such as 30s, 5m or 1h.
wttl.window.bad_unit: '%s' is not a unit. Use t for ticks, s, m or h.
wttl.window.not_positive: A window has to be longer than zero.
wttl.report.file_heading.auto: Automatic capture at %s - server averaging %s ms/tick, chunk held %s of chunk tick time
wttl.report.summary: %s ms per tick over %s ticks - %s object ticks in %ss
wttl.report.methods.summary: %s of %s server-thread samples fell inside the chunk
wttl.report.note.biased: NOTE: this sampler lands on safepoints, so hot spots are indicative, not exact.
wttl.report.note.buffer_full: NOTE: sample buffers filled; this covers only the earlier part of the inspection.
wttl.report.note.instance_cap: Distinct-object tracking hit its bound; type totals above are still complete.
